summary: Author compares Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5 on a single prompt to generate a Minecraft clone in one HTML file, demonstrating Opus 5.5's raw WebGL2 implementation with dynamic lighting and TNT in a synchronized gameplay screen recording.
summaryEn: Opus 5.5 Single-File Raw WebGL2 Minecraft Clone Comparison

post.originalText:
i gave 3 Claude models the same lazy prompt and one of them built creepers

the prompt: "make a minecraft clone. insane quality"

no specs. one HTML file each

what came back:

-> Haiku 5.5: 5 min, 31 KB. hills, trees, caves, mining. leans on three.js and the world just ends after 128 blocks
-> Sonnet 5.5: 10.6 min, 73 KB. raw WebGL2, infinite world, water, clouds, minimap, cracks when you mine. tbh way closer to Opus than i expected
-> Opus 5.5: ~15 min, 77 KB. raw WebGL2, real sun shadows, torch light that actually spreads, pigs, sheep, creepers at night, TNT with chain reactions

nobody asked for TNT

then i sent the exact same keypresses to all three at once. video below

wanna try it tonight:

1. pick one dumb prompt
2. run it on all 3 models, don't touch the output
3. put them side by side

takes about 30 seconds to see which one is worth paying for

save this before you pick a plan
